00046 ExternalControlSource::ExternalControlSource()  throw()
00047 : internal(0) 
00048 { 
00049 }
00050 
00051 ExternalControlSource::ExternalControlSource(ExternalControlSource const& copy) throw()
00052 : internal(0) 
00053 {
00054  internal = copy.internal;
00055  if(internal != 0) 
00056   internal->incrementRefCount();
00057 }
00058 
00059 ExternalControlSource& ExternalControlSource::operator= (ExternalControlSource const& other) throw()
00060 {
00061  if(this != &other) 
00062  {
00063   if(internal != 0) 
00064    internal->decrementRefCount();
00065   
00066   internal = other.internal;
00067   if(internal != 0) 
00068    internal->incrementRefCount();
00069  }
00070  
00071  return *this;
00072 }
00073 
00074 ExternalControlSource::~ExternalControlSource()  throw() 
00075 { 
00076  if(internal != 0) 
00077   internal->decrementRefCount();   
00078 }
00079 
00080 float ExternalControlSource::getValue() const throw()    
00081 { 
00082  ugen_assert(internal != 0);
00083  return internal == 0 ? 0.f : internal->getValue();  
00084 }
00085 
00086 const float* ExternalControlSource::getValuePtr() const throw()
00087 {
00088  ugen_assert(internal != 0);
00089  return internal == 0 ? 0 : internal->getValuePtr(); 
00090 }

00092 UGen ExternalControlSource::kr(const double lagTime) throw()
00093 {
00094  ugen_assert(lagTime >= 0.0);
00095  
00096  if(lagTime <= 0.0)
00097   return UGen(*this);
00098  else
00099   return UGen(Lag(*this, lagTime)).kr();
00100 }
